title: The Gaps between Pre-train and Downstream Settings in Bias Evaluation and Debiasing

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing likelihoods of feminine versus masculine sentences (pro-stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical) in pre-training intrinsic evaluations (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet, MBE) and measuring predictive differences in downstream tasks such as question answering, natural language inference, and coreference resolution (BBQ, BNLI, WinoBias).
